justification: Adds a reader provider used only when AI_MODEL=deepseek; its output still goes through the review queue, the word-for-word checker and the page/chunk guards before anything is published.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database read or written by this change; the provider turns a PDF chunk into the provisions JSON the other providers return
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The model counts pages within the piece it was sent; the provider adds the piece's offset so pages count from the chunk's first page, as the brief asks
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only new reads with AI_MODEL=deepseek; the default provider order is unchanged
pre_impl.external_source_error: An HTTP error propagates to _call_with_retry; a piece with rule pages that returns nothing is retried once, then printed and left to the pipeline's guards (ChunkLoss for an empty chunk, _reread_skipped_pages re-reads skipped pages and refuses the chapter if rules are still missing)
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change: the rows it produces are queue rows of the same shape as every other reader's
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A failed read fails the chapter's extraction with a message; nothing is enqueued for that chapter, so nothing is lost silently

functions.name: _call_deepseek
functions.input: the bytes of one PDF chunk and the brief, exactly as every other provider receives them
functions.output: a JSON string holding every provision of the chunk, pages counted from the chunk's first page
functions.if_none: a piece with rule pages that returns nothing is retried once, then reported and left to ChunkLoss / _reread_skipped_pages, which refuse the chapter if rules are still missing

values.if_missing: the piece's first page; _place_on_pages then places the rule by its words

queries.purpose: none: the provider runs no query; listed because the report requires one entry
queries.where_clause: not applicable: no SQL is run by this change
queries.if_zero: not applicable: no rows are read
queries.if_wrong: not applicable: no rows are written

break_it.scenario: A dense 12-page chunk overruns one answer's length cap
break_it.what_happens: the end of the chunk's rules would be cut off and missing from the read
break_it.how: the chunk is sent four pages at a time and the pieces are joined

break_it.scenario: Pages are counted per piece instead of per chunk
break_it.what_happens: a rule on page 5 of a chunk would be placed on page 1, linking the wrong page
break_it.how: the piece's start offset is added to the model's page

break_it.scenario: One piece silently returns no rules
break_it.what_happens: rules on those pages would be dropped and a full replace would delete them
break_it.how: retried once, then reported; the chunk-loss guard and _reread_skipped_pages refuse the chapter if a page of rules is still missing

break_it.scenario: The model returns a page outside the piece
break_it.what_happens: a rule would be placed on a page of another part of the chunk
break_it.how: _model_page refuses an out-of-range page and the piece's first page is used

break_it.scenario: The key is missing in the environment that runs the nightly job
break_it.what_happens: a read would fail with a bare KeyError deep inside a batch of chapters
break_it.how: the provider raises a RuntimeError naming OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and it is not in the default order

break_it.scenario: A pilot is run with --dry-run to see what a new reader produces
break_it.what_happens: the enrichment phases ran anyway and wrote provenance to production rows during a dry run
break_it.how: main() runs run_standard_enrichment only when not args.dry_run

break_it.scenario: A table rate is proven against the wrong use (a rate printed on another row of the same page)
break_it.what_happens: a parking or setback figure would be shown as the council's words for the wrong land use
break_it.how: every cell must sit on one printed row (within 6 points) and run left to right

falsifiable_check.fails_when: pieces lose their page offset, an empty piece is accepted, or the provider is not registered
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before this change _PROVIDERS had no 'deepseek' entry and the registration test fails with KeyError.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Scoring run 2026-10-12 (score_readers.py): CoS 271/271 and Hornsby 403/405 rules printed word for word.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: pilot one chapter with AI_MODEL=deepseek --dry-run and check the rule count and checker result
